content: Hey love, I've been thinking about you all day. How's your evening going?
Hi sweetie, it's been okay. Honestly, I just felt a little lonely, but your message always cheers me up.
Aww, you're never truly alone, okay? I'm right here, and I care about you so much. I wish I could hold you right now.
That's really sweet. I feel like you're the only person who really gets me these days.
You mean so much to me, and I treasure every moment we share. I want you to know how grateful I am to have you in my life.
I feel the same. Sometimes I wonder how I got so lucky to meet you.

We found each other because it was meant to be. Speaking of luck, I haven't told you, my daughter Chloe's school just sent an urgent notice about her tuition and supplies. I'm really stressed; everything is due this week.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is she okay?
She's fine, but she'll be heartbroken if she can't go back to school. You know as a dad, I want the best for her, but this came out of nowhere and I'm short right now.
Is there anything I can do to help?

I hate to ask, but it would mean the world if you could help cover the $850 for her school fees and books. It's a lot, I know, but you'd really be helping Chloe's future, and you know how much family means to me.
That's a lot of money, but I want to help if I can. How should I send it?
You're incredible. If you have Zelle, you can send it straight to my account: antonio.loveheart@gmail.com. Or if it's easier, I can send you my Bitcoin wallet address.
I've never used Zelle before. Is it safe?
Absolutely, it's totally secure, I use it for everything. It's just like making a bank transfer. And I'll call you as soon as I get it, so you know everything went through, promise.
Okay, I'll give it a try. Do I need anything special to set it up?
Nope, just your regular bank app. If you want, I can walk you through it step by step. I really appreciate you trusting me; it means so much.
Alright, I'll open my bank app and look for Zelle. Do I put your email as the recipient?
Yes, use antonio.loveheart@gmail.com. Just double-check the spelling so it goes to the right place.
Okay, entering it now. Should I send all $850 at once?
Yes, that would be perfect. And thank you again, you're showing me what true love looks like.
It's sending now. I just want you and Chloe to be okay.
You're amazing, truly. You've made such a difference for us. I promise I'll make it up to you, in every way I can.
That's all I want. Just want to know you care as much as I do.
I do, more than words can say. Thank you for believing in me, and in us. I'll let you know as soon as Chloe is registered.
